items.title: Bill Dobbins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rochester, New York, January 11, 2012
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Well thanks for inviting me, Monk.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe and I am off camera, but I’m happy to be in Rochester, New York at the Eastman School of Music talking to Professor Bill Dobbins. Thanks for joining me.
Well thanks for inviting me, Monk.
I hope my information is correct, but I found it really fascinating, I read when you were at Kent State there was no such thing as a jazz program there.
